prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady movement through a dense, fog-laden forest on Shengshan Island, Zhoushan, China, under a cloudy night sky. The camera pans slightly as it navigates over uneven terrain covered with moss and scattered foliage, capturing the muted greens and grays of the surrounding vegetation. As the viewer progresses, the path becomes more defined, bordered by a rustic wooden fence that guides the way forward. The camera angle shifts subtly, revealing a narrow dirt trail winding through the mist, with the dense fog obscuring distant views and creating an eerie atmosphere. The dim lighting enhances the sense of isolation, with occasional light flares adding a subtle glow to the scene. The path leads to a set of wooden steps, which the viewer ascends cautiously, the camera tilting upward to follow the ascent. Upon reaching the top, the viewer continues along a gravel path, flanked by dense trees and shrubs, their silhouettes barely visible through the thick fog. The environment remains empty and quiet, with no signs of human presence, emphasizing the solitude of the nocturnal journey through this natural setting. The camera maintains a steady pace, capturing the serene yet mysterious ambiance of the foggy night on the island.
